CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2606 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 83d21ff832455462268f1d9ce9d75c17a1209d07. Bus nonce: 85617c2d23cec9918f429629cd2c2d8f. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 83d21ff832455462268f1d9ce9d75c17a1209d07`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 83d21ff832455462268f1d9ce9d75c17a1209d07` or `Fix review: blocked 83d21ff832455462268f1d9ce9d75c17a1209d07 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 85617c2d23cec9918f429629cd2c2d8f`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `83d21ff832455462268f1d9ce9d75c17a1209d07` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2606 83d21ff832455462268f1d9ce9d75c17a1209d07") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2606-85617c2d`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Review of root-cause PR #2606 (group R10-RCA-INSTALL-RATELIMIT, branch fix/r10-rca-install-ratelimit) at head 83d21ff832455462268f1d9ce9d75c17a1209d07; code 0a8c4523a. It records only (dev/audit/rca/install-ratelimit.md plus dev/audit/harnesses/record_api_calls.sh) and changes no workflow. Judge it against dev/governance/roles/root-cause.md and .claude/rules/defect-root-cause.md, using fix-review.md's verdict shape. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
- Re-derive every figure at the body's base 04c1dd77990b97ae144e48cd29655853783532f2, NOT at current main. v7.0.3 was stamped at cd4aaed44 after the record was written, so the window at main is now about empty. The figures are: 834 = 94+370+370, the 3W+6P formula, 1,065 over v7.0.1, 0 on an empty window, 94 commits and 92 merges, 83 % of a 1,000/hr bucket, and "each red followed a burst of 4 to 6 main merges asking 3.2 to 4.6x the bucket". Check the burst claim against `TZ=UTC git log --first-parent` times around 06:27Z, 08:40Z and 09:44Z.
- Check the 1,000/hr GITHUB_TOKEN claim, and that the four red jobs read with GITHUB_TOKEN, against the workflow files. Check that the live record job at c409c9b18 read 91 PRs over 93 commits, from its log if a cheap read allows (spare the API).
- Judge the cause: is the record job what empties the bucket, or only one consumer among several? Judge the process state (c) and the cost test. Judge whether M1/M2 alone suffice or M3 is needed: the roster group R10-RECORD-API-BUDGET (being added) carries decision O-1, that --stats/--sunset move off the push arm.
- The harness: kill it by mutation (e.g. drop one mode, or count only commits) and show its figure moves. Its null control must read TOTAL 0.
- The carries are landed on handoff/audit-r10-roster: R10-FLY-GH-READ-RETRY 9326f8a4e and R10-CI-LAYOUT-P2 d9f33a0f2. carry_audit.py check over the body gives 0 unrouted. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 83d21ff832455462268f1d9ce9d75c17a1209d07 must be clean.
- Read check-runs at this head. A red whose log shows "API rate limit exceeded" is external. nightly-status and delivery-status are not required.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head, and VERDICT carries bus-nonce: 85617c2d23cec9918f429629cd2c2d8f. No /Users/ or /private/ path may appear in VERDICT.md or ev/.
